questions.question: Find the average of p and q if the average of 22, 15, 28, p and q is 16.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 22, 15, 28, p and q is 16

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of terms/Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ (22 + 15 + 28 + p + q)/5 = 16

⇒ 65 + p + q = 80

⇒ p + q = 15

Average of p and q = (p + q)/2 = 15/2 = 7.5

**∴ The average of p and q is 7.5**

questions.question: 45% of the total candidates who appeared for an examination were girls. 75% of the boys and 80% of the girls passed, and 144 girls failed. How many boys failed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Girls = 45%

Boys passed = 75%

Girls passed = 80%

Girls failed = 144

**Calculation:**

Let total students = 400

Girls = 45% = 45/100 × 400 = 180

Boys = 55% = 55/100 × 400 = 220

Boys passed = 75% = 3/4 × 220 = 165

Boys failed = 220 - 165 = 55

Girls passed = 80% = 4/5 × 180 = 144

Girls failed = 180 - 144 = 36

⇒ 36 units = 144 (According to question)

⇒ 1 unit = 4

Boys failed = 55 × 4 = 220

**∴ The correct answer is** **220**.

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 4 : 9 : 7. If the sum of the shortest and the longest sides is 65 cm, then what is the length of the third side? (in cm)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 4 : 9 : 7

The sum of the shortest and the longest sides is 65 cm.

**Calculation:**

Shortest side of the triangle = 4 units

Longest side of the triangle = 9 units

The sum of the shortest and the longest sides = 4 + 9

⇒ 13 units

According to the question,

13 units = 65 cm

So, 1 unit = 5 cm

Length of the third side = 7 × 5

⇒ 35 cm

**∴ The required answer is 35 cm.**

questions.question: What is the greatest 5-digit number which on being divided by 3, 5, 6 and 9 leaves remainders 1, 3, 4 and 7, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 The greatest 5-digit number which on being divided by 3, 5, 6 and 9 leaves remainders 1, 3, 4 and 7, respectively

**Solution:**

LCM of 3, 5, 6 and 9 = 90

We Know that the greatest 5 digit number = 99999

The greatest 5 digit number which is divisible by 90 = 99990

To get remainders 1, 3, 4, 7 when divided by 3, 5, 6, 9 respectively we find difference of these umbers, As

⇒ 3 - 1 = 2

⇒ 5 - 3 = 2

⇒ 6 - 4 = 2

⇒ 9 - 7 = 2

Therefore, The greatest 5-digit number which on being divided by 3, 5, 6 and 9 leaves remainders 1, 3, 4 and 7, respectively

⇒ 99990 - 2 = **99988**

questions.question: The distance between a man and a 230m long train is 115 m. How much time (in seconds) will the train, which is running at a speed of 60 km/h, take to pass the man who is running at a speed of 9 km/h towards the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train = 60 km/h

Speed of man = 9 km/h

Train length = 230 m

Distance between Man and Train = 115 m

**Concept used:**

Relative Speed = Relative Distance/Time

Where Relative speed is sum of man and train speed because they move towards each other.

**Calculation:**

Relative Distance = 230 + 115

⇒ 345 m 

Relative speed = Speed of train + speed of man

⇒ 60 + 9 = 69 km/h

⇒ 69 × (5/18) m/sec

Time taken to pass the man = Relative Distance/Relative speed

⇒ frac {345}{(69 times 5/18)}

⇒ 18 sec

**∴ The Required time is 18 sec.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__**If the man and the train move towards each other then 

Relative speed = Speed of train + Speed of man.

If the man and the train move in same direction then,

Relative Speed = Speed of train - Speed of man.

questions.question: What is the altitude of a trapezium, the sum of the lengths of whose parallel sides is 9.5 cm and the area is 57 cm²?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the lengths of trapezium parallel sides is 9.5 cm.

The area of the trapezium is 57 cm2.

**Formula used:**

Area of Trapezium = 1/2 × sum of lengths of parallel sides × Altitude

**Calculation:**

Area of Trapezium = 1/2 × sum of lengths of parallel sides × Altitude

⇒ 57 = 1/2 × 9.5 × altitude 

⇒ Altitude = 57 × 2/9.5

⇒ 12 cm

**∴ The Required answer is 12 cm.**

questions.question: A sum of ₹2,50,000 is invested for one and a half years at 12% per annum compound interest. What is the difference between the amounts received when the interest is compounded semi-annually and when it is compounded annually?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Effective CI rate (annually) for 1.5 years at 12% = 12% + 6% + (12 × 6) ÷ 100 = 18.72% Effective CI rate (semi-annually) for 3 half-years at 6% = 3(6) + 3(6)² ÷ 100 + (6)³ ÷ 10000 = 18 + 1.08 + 0.0216 = 19.1016% Difference in effective rate = 19.1016% − 18.72% = 0.3816% Difference in amount = 0.3816% of 2,50,000 = (0.3816 ÷ 100) × 250000 = ₹954 **∴ The correct answer is ₹954.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:** Principal (P) = ₹2,50,000 Rate (R) = 12% per annum Time (T) = 1.5 years Compounded Annually (1.5 years): ₹2,50,000 • +12% (1st yr) ₹2,80,000 • +6% (½ yr) ₹2,96,800 Compounded Semi-Annually (3 half-years): ₹2,50,000 • +6% ₹2,65,000 • +6% ₹2,80,900 • +6% ₹2,97,754 Difference = ₹2,97,754 − ₹2,96,800 = ₹954 **Calculations:** ⇒ Amount compounded annually (A₁) = P × (1 + R/100)¹ × (1 + (R/2)/100) ⇒ A₁ = 250000 × (1 + 12/100) × (1 + 6/100) ⇒ A₁ = 250000 × 1.12 × 1.06 = 250000 × 1.1872 ⇒ A₁ = ₹2,96,800 ⇒ Amount compounded semi-annually (A₂) = P × (1 + (R/2)/100)²T ⇒ A₂ = 250000 × (1 + 6/100)³ ⇒ A₂ = 250000 × (1.06)³ = 250000 × 1.191016 ⇒ A₂ = ₹2,97,754 ⇒ Difference in amounts = A₂ − A₁ ⇒ Difference = 297754 − 296800 = ₹954 **∴ The correct answer is ₹954.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Effective Rate Method For 3 equal periods at rate R%, the effective compound interest rate is calculated as: 3R + 3R²/100 + R³/10000. Half-Yearly Compounding When interest is compounded semi-annually, the annual rate of interest is divided by 2 (R/2) and the number of years is multiplied by 2 (2T). questions.question: A sum of ₹3,596 is divided between A, B, and C in the ratio (1)/(6) : (1)/(8): (1)/(9). What is the difference (in ₹) between the shares of A and C?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of the denominators 6, 8, and 9 is 72. Multiplying fractions by 72 gives integer ratio.

A : B : C = (1/6 × 72) : (1/8 × 72) : (1/9 × 72) = 12 : 9 : 8

Total units = 12 + 9 + 8 = 29 units → ₹3,596

1 unit = ₹3,596 ÷ 29 = ₹124

Difference between A and C = 12 − 8 = 4 units → 4 × 124 = 496

**∴ The correct answer is ₹496.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount to be divided = ₹3,596

Initial ratio of shares of A, B, and C = 1/6 : 1/8 : 1/9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be1bac796580755e9a2ebd76c90202d85a7281565697f8f63d8a1108b415c728.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM of the denominators 6, 8, and 9 is 72.

⇒ Multiplying each fraction by 72 to get simple integer ratios:

⇒ Share of A = 1/6 × 72 = 12 units

⇒ Share of B = 1/8 × 72 = 9 units

⇒ Share of C = 1/9 × 72 = 8 units

⇒ Simplified ratio of shares A : B : C = 12 : 9 : 8

⇒ Total sum of ratio units = 12 + 9 + 8 = 29 units

⇒ We know, 29 units = ₹3,596

⇒ 1 unit = 3596 ÷ 29 = 124

⇒ Difference in ratio between A and C = 12 units − 8 units = 4 units

⇒ Total difference in amount = 4 × 124 = 496

**∴ The correct answer is ₹496.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Simplification

To convert fractional ratios into simplest integer ratios, multiply each fraction by the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of all the denominators.

Proportion

When two ratios are equal, they are said to be in proportion (a/b = c/d). The core rule of proportion is that the product of the extremes equals the product of the means (a × d = b × c).

Distribution of Amount

If a total quantity T is to be divided among participants in the ratio a : b : c, the individual share can be calculated as Share = (Individual Ratio Unit ÷ Total Ratio Units) × T.

questions.question: A salesman sold a watch at a loss of 15%. If the selling price had been increased by ₹150, there would have been a gain of 5%. What was the cost price of the watch?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Loss = 15%

If SP is increased by Rs. 150 then profit is 5%.

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (100 - L%)/100

SP = CP × (100 + P%)/100

**Calculation:**

Let CP be Rs. x

When loss is 15% then,

SP = (100 - 15)x/100 = 85x/100

⇒ SP = 17x/20

When Profit is 5% then,

SP = (100 + 5)x/100 = 105x/100

⇒ SP = 21x/20

According to the question,

21x/20 - 17x/20 = 150

⇒ 4x/20 = 150

⇒ x = 750

**Hence the CP is Rs. 750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 Let CP be 100x

⇒ SP at 15% loss = 85x

⇒ SP at 5% profit = 105x

According to the question,

105x - 85x = 150

⇒ 20x = 150

⇒ 100x = 750.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 750**

questions.question: The average score of a group of students in a test is 58. The average score of the brightest 15% of the students is 85 and that of the poorest 20% of the students is 28. What is the average score of the remaining students?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average score of a group of students in a test is 58

The average score of the brightest 15% of the students is 85

The average score of the poorest 20% of the students is 28.

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements / No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students in a group be X.

Sum of scores of students = 58 X

Sum of 15% brightest students = (X × 15/100) × 85

⇒ 12.75 X

Sum of 20% poorest students = (X × 20/100) × 28

⇒ 5.6 X

Remaining Students = 100 - 15 - 20 

⇒ 65%

Sum of remaining 65% students = Total - Sum of 15% - Sum of 20%

⇒ 58 X - 12.75 X - 5.6 X

⇒ 39.65 X

Average of Remaining 65% students = 39.65 X/(X × 65%)

⇒ 3965/65

⇒ 61

**∴ The Required Answer is 61. **

questions.question: If 16% of x = 24% of y, then how much is 24% of x?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ (16 × x)/100 = (24 × y)/100

⇒ 16x = 24y

⇒ x = (3/2)y

Now, 24% of x = 24% of (3/2)y = 36% of y

**Hence, the correct answer is 36% of y.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

⇒ 16% of x = 24% of y

⇒ 1% of x = (24/16)% of y

⇒ 24% of x = [(3/2) × 24]% of y

⇒ 24% of x = 36% of y

**∴ 36% of y is the correct answer.**
